he.short: הדמיה להמחשה בלבד. הופקה בסיוע בינה מלאכותית מתכנית המכר של דירה {UNIT}, {PROJECT}, מיום {PLAN_DATE}. המסמכים המחייבים הם המפרט והתכניות החתומים. ריהוט, גימורים ונוף להמחשה.
he.long:
הדמיה להמחשה בלבד.
ההדמיה הופקה על ידי Habait עבור {DEVELOPER} בסיוע כלי בינה מלאכותית, על בסיס תכנית המכר של דירה {UNIT} בפרויקט {PROJECT} מיום {PLAN_DATE} (אדריכל: {ARCHITECT}). הגאומטריה של הדירה (חדרים, קירות, פתחים) נגזרה מתכנית המכר; מראה החומרים, התאורה, הריהוט, האביזרים, הצמחייה, האנשים והנוף הם פרשנות חזותית ואינם חלק מהממכר.
המסמכים המחייבים הם אך ורק המפרט הטכני (לפי חוק המכר (דירות), תשל"ג-1973, וצו מכר דירות (טופס של מפרט), תשל"ד-1974) והתכניות החתומות המצורפות לחוזה המכר. בכל סתירה בין ההדמיה לבין המפרט והתכניות, המפרט והתכניות גוברים.
ריהוט, גימורים, כלים סניטריים, מטבח, ארונות, תאורה ואביזרים אינם כלולים בדירה אלא אם נאמר במפורש במפרט. גוונים, חומרים ופריטים שמופיעים בהדמיה עשויים להיות שונים מאלה שיסופקו בפועל.
שטחים ומידות הם לפי תכניות היזם והמפרט; המידות בהדמיה מוצגות באופן מקורב ואינן מהוות מדידה. מיקום עמודים, קורות, פירים ומערכות עשוי להשתנות בהתאם לתכנון המפורט ולהוראות כל דין.
הסביבה, הבניינים השכנים, הנוף והתאורה הטבעית מוצגים להמחשה בלבד ואינם מתחייבים.
הופק: {GEN_DATE}, גרסה {VERSION}. גילוי: חלקים מההדמיה נוצרו או עובדו באמצעות בינה מלאכותית.

en.short: Illustration only. Generated with AI assistance from the sales plan of unit {UNIT}, {PROJECT}, dated {PLAN_DATE}. The binding documents are the signed specification and plans. Furniture, finishes and views are illustrative.
en.long:
Illustration only.
This visualization was produced by Habait for {DEVELOPER} with the assistance of artificial-intelligence tools, based on the sales plan of unit {UNIT} in {PROJECT} dated {PLAN_DATE} (architect: {ARCHITECT}). The apartment geometry (rooms, walls, openings) is derived from the sales plan; materials, lighting, furniture, accessories, vegetation, people and views are a visual interpretation and are not part of the property sold.
The binding documents are solely the technical specification (under the Sale (Apartments) Law, 5733-1973, and the Sale (Apartments) (Specification Form) Order, 5734-1974) and the signed plans attached to the sale agreement. In any discrepancy between this visualization and the specification and plans, the specification and plans prevail.
Furniture, finishes, sanitary fixtures, kitchen, closets, lighting and accessories are not included unless expressly stated in the specification. Colours, materials and items shown may differ from those actually supplied.
Areas and dimensions are per the developer's plans and specification; dimensions in the visualization are approximate and do not constitute a measurement. The location of columns, beams, shafts and building systems may change according to the detailed design and applicable law.
Surroundings, neighbouring buildings, views and natural light are shown for illustration only and are not guaranteed.
Produced {GEN_DATE}, version {VERSION}. Disclosure: parts of this visualization were created or processed using artificial intelligence.

en.micro: Illustration only · AI-assisted · Binding: the signed specification and plans

metadata.state: proposed, not implemented; question 8 for counsel (EU AI Act art. 50(2) machine-readable marking)

variants.short: unit-level, one line: interior frames, apartment panos, stills, the 3D tab, apartment and landing pages next to media
variants.long: unit-level, paragraph: page footers, "about" screens, ZIP README
variants.short_project: NEW in v1, not pinned by any test: project/exterior level where there is no unit and the geometry is the building mass (aerial orbit, hold screen, building picker, turntable, exterior 360 nodes)
variants.micro: NEW in v1, not pinned by any test: a persistent corner line where the short line cannot be legible (video corner, reel, equirect watermark); never alone: the short or short_project must be on the same screen or on the opening/closing card
variants.ai_disclosure: the AI sentence on its own, for metadata and for outputs that carry micro only

video_overlay.outputs: aerial orbit, approach/descent, enter-846 clips, flyover video (cards 17/18/20, habait-98's flow)
video_overlay.variant: short_project (exterior) or short (clips that end inside the apartment)
video_overlay.placement: opening card >= 3 s burned into the frames + micro as a persistent corner line, text height >= 2.5% of the frame

pano_overlay.outputs: 360 viewer (tour360 apartment tour, exterior 360 nodes, flyover3d hold)
pano_overlay.placement: fixed bottom line in the viewer HTML + long behind an "about this visualization" button + micro burned into the equirect bottom so a shared screenshot keeps it

hold_screen.outputs: the stop in front of the building with the unit picker (flow.html .picker-disclaimer, :8899 hold)
hold_screen.placement: fixed line under the picker; the unit card shows short with the unit filled

page_footer.placement: footer, he + en by page language; the short sits next to each visual

apartment_page.outputs: apartment.html (card 23): every tab incl. the 3D tab (card 10)
apartment_page.variant: short under every tab (.legal-short) + long in the footer and in "about"
apartment_page.state: live, reads the md through build_zip

landing_page.variant: short next to the media and in the lightbox + long in the footer
landing_page.state: live, template pinned to the md by test/landing.test.mjs

zip_readme.placement: with PLAN_DATE and the sha256 of the plan crop used

stills.outputs: stills cut from panos (ZIP, landing tiles, lightbox)
stills.variant: short burned into the bottom margin

tab_3d.outputs: the 3D tab (card 10) and the offline dollhouse.html in the ZIP
tab_3d.variant: short under the canvas + long in <details>

reel.variant: micro persistent + short on the end card >= 3 s

rules: The caption sits next to the visual on the same screen or in the same frame; a footer or README alone is not enough (sources.md S7: reservations that are not in the ad are not imputed to the reader; a first misleading contact stays misleading).
Placeholders are filled automatically from plan.json / project.json / units.json; a published output never contains "{".
The text is identical in every output; any wording change = a new caption version + counsel.
Same language as the page; bilingual outputs carry both.
Never the competitor wording "areas ... not verified" / "אינם מאומתים": it contradicts the product (geometry from the sales plan, documented gates).
Until counsel signs off: status DRAFT, private pitch only (project.json legal.publish_allowed false).
